task: explore: new research-algorithm tool pairwise-ranking (Bradley-Terry with Davidson ties, home advantage, rank ranges, Ford existence check)

errors.what: First reference run included a random tournament whose home sides won every game; the MLE is at infinity, so scipy and the engine stopped at different ridge points (loglik equal to 1e-9, strengths 2.3 apart).
errors.fix: Engine now detects runaway parameters and refits with a prior on all parameters (warned); reference skips draws with |param|>6; dedicated test added.

errors.what: An engine test wrongly assumed one win plus one tie between two players has a finite Davidson MLE.
errors.fix: Test corrected; PAPERS/README/page say Ford's condition is necessary but not sufficient with ties or a home term.

errors.what: Header detector took a bare 'A,B' data row for a header, and the result reader mapped football-data's 'A' (away) to the first side.
errors.fix: Dropped single-letter header words; name matches are checked before result codes.

errors.what: engine.mjs carried a literal U+FEFF in its BOM-stripping regex; check_hidden_unicode.py failed in the local ventures-tests run.

doc_friction.issue: Exceeded the 120 s tool timeout in the foreground (it runs main_health.py and site tests); had to rerun it with run_in_background. portfolio/research-tools/README.md describes it without the duration.

A pure-Python likelihood loop with a numerical Hessian took about 3 minutes for 30 cases; worth noting that vectorising, or running it in the background from the start, saves a wasted foreground call.

notes: Idea: pairwise-ranking, a standalone Bradley-Terry tool (no venture took head-to-head results as input; quick-pick-survey only uses BT internally). Verification: 30 independent statsmodels/scipy fits reproduced (strengths 1e-7/2e-5, SEs 1e-6/0.1%), MM agrees with Newton to 1e-9, 38 venture tests and 41 inter-rater-agreement tests pass via run_venture_tests.py, Chromium render with no console errors and no overflow at 390 px. Finding: on 2023-24 Premier League results City top only 59% of simulated seasons; home factor 1.66, p=0.0003. The agent doc is the README (method, existence caveat and verification); no separate docs/reports doc was needed. Local CI (run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes; no PR check runs had appeared): portfolio-validate 100/100, portfolio-pages 12/12, pages 6/6, every other triggered workflow green; ventures-tests failed only on the hidden-unicode check, fixed and re-run green (run_venture_tests.py 79 tests, test_check_hidden_unicode OK). venture-preflight.mjs: clean.
